name: Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs secured and hold the neutral grip handle with arms extended.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest tall.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are straight.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A lat pulldown with a neutral (palms facing each other) grip that is often more comfortable on the shoulders.
